summary: Phase 5 of the Plane of Time represents the final collapse of all timelines. Mortals confront the apex of temporal instability, battling entities formed from the annihilation of reality itself.
history: Phase 5 formed when all temporal layers converged into a single unstable core.
Cataclysmic echoes emerged from the destruction of infinite timelines.
The Cataclysmic Paradox arose as the ultimate temporal anomaly.
